title: Normalized scalar evaluation for the fixed universal cochain system model
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l and an embedding iota:E to L. For each scheme W and n>=0, construct a natural isomorphism from integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar followed by finite L-evaluation to finite E-evaluation followed by pbcDerivedExtend along the recorded quotient sheaf map. It is the scalar-adjunction transpose of identity-on-sections restriction evaluation, transported to the fixed system model and fixed finite pbc model. The actual system adjunction is normalized by its ordinary tensor unit and universal cochain transpose. There are no boundedness, constructibility, completeness, or flatness hypotheses.
